items.title: Abbey Lincoln — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: meeting Jean-Philippe has made it all mellow... How do you work together on albums

ctx.x: This was especially after "Straight Ahead," right?

After "Straight Ahead" and before it, too. CBS never called and asked me for anything, neither did ABC or anybody else. So, I've been with Verve Polygram France for the last six years and my career has increased. The audience has increased because they got a chance to hear me. They would have come before if somebody had presented me, but I'm glad it's now because I've mellowed in my mature years and I hope that I will be more and more compassionate and I don't want to hurt anybody, but meeting Jean-Philippe has…
